question: What great reality abides above bindu ending in half-moon and nirodhi?
premises: In Sadakhya abides one with a great body of five mantras.
He abides there in a supreme form.
Above the covering of bindu ending in half-moon and nirodhi there is a great reality.
inference: Beyond the bindu sequence, in supreme form, dwells the great five-mantra-bodied lord.
uncertainties: The compound ityardhendunirodhyantabindvāvṛtyūrdhvato is dense and its internal boundaries are interpretive.
plain_english: There, in supreme form, abides the one whose great body is made of the five mantras. Thus, above the covering of bindu that ends in the half-moon and nirodhi, there is a great presence.
